message:
feat(keepalive-multi r1): one decoder, bound to one PC at a time -- a token on every sink call

The decoder and its Surface stay single; each PC connection's controller will be given
its own EntrySinkAdapter carrying the binding token that PC was put on screen with.
Every sink entry point has a token form (frames, stream reset, discontinuity, decode
episode, selection answer / tag, key request, owed key, decode generation, decode and
presentation stats, selection prepare / abort) that compares the token with the current
binding under the decoder's own lock before touching anything; the lock-free stats read
compares it inside the same published copy (ClientDecodeState.binding). Bind resets
everything a binding owned; Unbind with a stale token changes nothing. The old virtual
methods are the always-owner form (tests, single use).
android_decoder_binding_test 10/0: a closing B's late reset / frame / selection answer /
episode / unbind and its stats drain touch nothing of the bound A (A's next delta still
decodes); B->A->B: B's first binding is stale too. Negative control (0.2.30: every
controller had the decoder itself): B's late reset stops A's picture.
owed_key 32/0, geometry 10/0. decode_stats: the old timing items only (alternating
15+15 runs: before 5x4 / 8x2 failed, after 2x4 / 10x2).

제품/테스트/문서: 제품(APK decoder, 아직 브리지 연결 전) + 테스트
